newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Guoco trading buy - Urbancorp.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Guoco trading buy - Urbancorp.

text.p: Guoco Holdings (Philippines) Inc was rated a trading buy by Urbancorp Securities on Tuesday following its planned purchase of a majority stake in Pepsi-Cola Products Philippines Inc, the franchise holder of Pepsi products.
Guoco Holdings, which is a unit of Hong Kong's Guoco Group Ltd, announced the deal on January 13.
"We believe that with the company's diversified holdings and recent acquisitions, it is in a good position to maintain its income growth," Urbancorp said.

At its current price of 4.15 pesos a share, Guoco is trading at a price-earnings multiple of 5.3 times versus forecast 1997 earnings per share of 0.78 peso, the report said. The 1997 forecast is 24 percent higher than the projected 0.63 peso earnings per share in 1996.
"The issue is oversold, and we anticipate an upmove in the share price within the next few days," Urbancorp added.

Guoco holds a stake in the Amari Coastal Bay Development Corp which will reclaim and develop 750 hectares of land along Manila Bay. Its share price had suffered recently due to allegations Amari's contract with the government was underpriced.
Apart from real estate, Guoco has extensive holdings in banking, and manufacturing of ceramic tiles and construction materials.
